summary: game_dialogs 003 (Game4): move to kit; add glowing +/- buttons to the kit
author: pm
body:
The user, 2026-11-25, sheet by sheet: "001 - The kit should have all of these" (HH-0091); "002 - We can recreate those too"; "003 - Should already exist minus the glowing + - buttons - which we can add to the kit and recreate the rest"; "004 - The dialog can go as we can recreate it - but the rest can stay."; "005 - that's fine"; "006 - We can recreate that as well"; "010 - we can remove this entirely since the kit already includes that too".

Sheet 003 (InterfaceNdGame4) is used in about 10 dialogs (stat arrows 5/6, the majestic stat table, map and notice pieces, as of 2026-11-25). User: "003 - Should already exist minus the glowing + - buttons - which we can add to the kit and recreate the rest". Map each live frame to its existing kit piece; add the glowing +/- buttons to the panel kit (kit change goes through tools/panel_kit and its build); recreate anything else. Then empty sprite 3 and archive 003.png.

**Done when:** every live use draws from the kit at the same place and with the same look, the sheet's retired frames are no longer loaded, retired images are archived byte-identical to working/archive/interface/game_dialogs/ with empty manifest placeholders, both builds are clean, and in-client screenshots of each affected dialog are attached.
